arguments.cmd:
echo "=== Kali VM ==="
echo -n "CPU核: "; nproc
echo -n "型号: "; grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo | cut -d: -f2
free -h | head -2
echo -n "OS: "; . /etc/os-release; echo "$PRETTY_NAME"
uname -r
echo "磁盘:"; df -h / | tail -1
echo "专项venv:"; ls -d /home/kali/ctf-workbench/.venv-specialists 2>/dev/null && du -sh /home/kali/ctf-workbench 2>/dev/null
